title: Collective Velocity: 30/60/90 Compact and All-Hands Runbook (draft)
body:
PURPOSE

A compact planning artifact to align the company on the next 90 days of work (30/60/90 cadence), the set of proposed company-level OKRs for exec review, and the all-hands agenda + presenter notes for the town. This is intentionally lightweight — a single doc for execs and facilitators to run from during the next staging and rehearsal cycle.

TL;DR
- Proposed company OKRs (draft) — 3 objectives, each with 2–4 measurable KRs.
- All-hands format: 40m exec updates + 20m Q&A + 20m breakout demos/pulse checks.
- Communication timeline and rehearsal plan for week of Feb 16.
- Primary risks and mitigations + clear owner list for follow-ups.

CONTEXT / WHY NOW
- We need a tighter cadence between product bet alignment, infra capacity prep (Dedicated & Private lanes), and customer-facing SLAs.
- Recent spikes in hosted usage during experiments highlighted routing fallback gaps (see JIRA-1873).
- Execs want a short, decisive set of OKRs to cascade into Q2 planning and resource commitments.

PROPOSED COMPANY-LEVEL OKRs (DRAFT)
Objective A: Make inference predictable and cost-efficient for production workloads
- KR A1: 20% reduction in median per-token CPU/GPU cost across top 10 customer workloads (benchmarked).
- KR A2: Decrease 95th percentile serving latency by 15% for our hosted API across p50-p95 windows.
- KR A3: Ship two new Optimize recommendations (auto-batching/caching presets) and measure adoption in 8 pilot customers.

Objective B: Expand enterprise readiness and Private deployment adoption
- KR B1: Close three Paid Private pilots (VPC/on-prem) with documented deployment runbooks and SLAs.
- KR B2: Audit and remediate top 10 compliance items for Private (KMS, audit logs) — evidence in compliance tracker.
- KR B3: Reduce onboarding time for Dedicated customers from signup to first successful inference job by 30%.

Objective C: Developer experience and ecosystem velocity
- KR C1: Ship language SDK parity (feature gap < 5%) across Python/TS/Go with updated examples.
- KR C2: Cut average time to reproduce a customer incident (first repro in SLO timeframe) by 40%.
- KR C3: Publish two reference apps that demonstrate cost-effective serving patterns, with benchmarks.

NOTES ON METRICS & ASSUMPTIONS
- Cost/KR measurements will use the billing baseline from Jan 2026 and the infra telemetry bucket tagged "okrs-bench-v1".
- Latency baseline gathered from hosted-api/perf-dashboard; small sample variance expected across regions.
- Adoption pilot = >3 customers integrating optimize presets into a production route for >= 7 days.

ROLL-OUT & COMMUNICATION TIMELINE
- Feb 12: Finalize draft OKRs with exec edits (this doc).
- Feb 15: Pre-brief managers + leads; send pre-read to all staff. (Owners: Ava / Marco)
- Feb 17: Exec rehearsal (30m) + Town run-through (facilitators). (Owners: Priya / Samir)
- Feb 19: Company all-hands + public blog mini-post summarizing top-level OKRs and asks. (Owner: Elena)
body_continued:
ALL-HANDS AGENDA (60m)
- 0:00–00:05 — Opening & context (CEO) — framing: mission -> why these OKRs matter. Rehearsal note: CEO callouts: reliability, cost, and Private expansion.
- 00:05–00:25 — Exec updates (3x 6m): Product (Priya), Platform/Infra (Marco), Developer/SDK (Samir). Each should include 1 headline, 1 metric, 1 ask.
- 00:25–00:40 — OKR highlight + commitments (Ava) — present the 3 objectives, where we are, 2 priority bets per objective.
- 00:40–00:55 — Live Q&A (moderated by Elena). Collect unanswered Qs to a follow-up thread.
- 00:55–01:00 — Quick wins & next steps (All).

PRESENTER NOTES
- Keep slides light (no more than 2 charts each). Use the one-line "ask" per slide.
- Execs should rehearse their 6 minute slot and give 1 direct ask to managers. Example ask: "We need two infra engineers on Caching Pilot by Mar 1 — please commit."
- Avoid deep technical demos during the main stage — instead run 20m breakout/demo rooms post-town for product teams to show details.

COMMUNICATIONS (PRE-READ & POST)
- Pre-read (Feb 15): Short doc + 1-pager (one slide) with headline OKRs. Post to Confluence + slack channel #company-allhands. (Linked artifact above).
- Post all-hands: Publish minutes + recording + follow-up thread summarizing answers to top 10 questions.

REHEARSAL CHECKLIST
- Deck submitted to /okrs/rehearsals on Feb 16 EOD. (Owner: Priya)
- Dry run with CEO + two execs on Feb 17 10:00–10:30 PT. (Owner: Priya)
- AV check + breakout links validated 24h before.

RISKS & MITIGATIONS (short)
- Risk: OKRs appear too engineering-centric and lose product/CS buy-in.
  - Mitigation: Add explicit customer-facing KRs (B1/B3) and have CS co-present.
- Risk: Measured improvements rely on infra changes that slip past Q2.
  - Mitigation: Prioritize one high-impact infra change per objective and create rollout gating criteria.
- Risk: All-hands goes long, losing attention.
  - Mitigation: Strict rehearsal timing and a moderator with a visible timer.

OPEN QUESTIONS (needs decisions)
- Do we want a single cross-functional owner for each Objective, or split ownership per KR? (Recommend: Objective owner + KR leads).
- Which external customer pilots qualify for "Paid Private pilot" KR credit? (List to be finalized by CS by Feb 14).
- Which two reference apps should be prioritized for KR C3? (Proposals: analytics-rewriter + customer-chatbot).

NEXT STEPS (immediate)
- Today (Ava): circulate this doc to execs for edits; collect edits by Feb 12 EOD.
- Feb 12–14 (Marco/Priya): finalize metric sources and confirm measurability for each KR.
- Feb 15 (Elena): prepare pre-read and schedule manager sync.
- Feb 17 (Samir): run exec rehearsal and update deck.

ACTION OWNERS (quick list)
- Ava Chen — OKR owner, pre-read + town facilitation.
- Marco Reyes — infra metrics & risk lead (JIRA-1873 follow-up).
- Priya Nair — product OKR alignment, deck curation.
- Samir Kapoor — devex/SDK parity status & rehearsal lead.
- Elena Morales — comms, recording, Q&A moderation.

NOTES TO SELF / WORKING ITEMS
- Assemble a one-pager for managers: what to cascade, what to deprioritize, and hiring asks.
- Create a follow-up Linear board for OKR tasks (link to be added).
- Confirm Dedicated onboarding measurement method with Billing team.

APPENDIX: QUICK LINKS AND REFERENCES
- Confluence master: https://confluence.redwood.example/display/VP/collective-velocity
- Perf incident: JIRA-1873 (routing fallback)
- OKR repo PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/okrs/pull/42
- Slack pre-brief thread: slack:#company-allhands

---
Draft — expect edits. This is a working document; treat it as the single source for exec and all-hands prep until Feb 17 rehearsal. Notes may be rough and there will be follow-ups logged in JIRA/Linear.
